scope.purpose: Exact database wallet matching plus bounded token-history state. No behavioral verdicts, risk scoring, predictions, wallet ranking, or final evidence score.
principles: Current holders and historical participants are both retained.
A wallet is not removed from Phase 7 when its current balance is zero.
Multiple roles and multiple appearances are preserved.
Role weight and token-position profile are separate dimensions.
Phase 7 records observed facts; Phase 8 performs deeper behavior/timeline analysis.
UNKNOWN is preserved when history coverage is insufficient.
A transfer-out is not automatically classified as a sell unless Helius enhanced transaction type supports SWAP/SELL evidence.

position.note: Observed duration is a bounded Phase 7 history span, not a complete behavioral holding analysis.
